remarks: Discover comfort, style, and convenience all in this cozy, beautiful and elegant condo! Perfect starter to build memories, downsizing or for a smart investment! It has an open layout where the spacious Living Room seamlessly flows into the Dining Area and the thoughtfuly upgraded kitchen with new built-in appliances, fixtures, cabinets and granite counter tops. The 2 generously size Bedrooms and the remodeled Bathroom are strategically located closer for more privacy and convenience. Synthetic wood flooring throughout for easy maintenance.
